palette_rationale: Corrected 64-color Idle palette is the shared source for all actions. Green source eyes and restrained black edges are applied only to source-visible coverage after action assembly.
reference: Own chr707 DSTS skeleton and clips. No external pose or pixel reference used.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native rapid quadruped stride, endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright hand strike and recovery, with contact around .62s.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native head and open-mouth release gesture. No projectile asset implied.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouched/resting breath. Eye closure must be verified at sprite size; no synthetic lids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward head/body recoil and recovery.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised arm and open-jaw sweeping strike.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two retimed native arm-strike cycles; engine has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright lift and spring/recovery, distinct from forward arm strike; inspect shadow gap.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native body rise and head lift through roughly 1.65s, then reverse to neutral; no effect asset.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native look gesture plus explicit whole-view yaw; source has no confirmed full-body 360 clip.
